title: T1078 — Valid Accounts
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Valid Accounts with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker buys an employee's VPN credentials on a criminal market, logs into the company VPN, looks around, copies files from a file server, moves to a second server, and is detected and stopped by the SOC.

steps.title: Buying access
steps.caption: The attacker visits a criminal market and buys the VPN credentials of an employee, "j.wilson". The seller stole them in an earlier phishing campaign. This trade happens on an outside forum, so your network sees nothing yet
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.

steps.title: Lateral use
steps.caption: The attacker tries the same password on a second server, and it works, because the employee reused the password. The same source IP has now logged into two hosts within minutes - a strong correlation signal
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
